sequence.description: Input protein sequence as a single-letter string of standard amino acids. Only ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY are accepted. Gaps, unknown residues (X), and ambiguous codes (B/Z/U/O/J) are not supported. Preferred over structure_path.

structure_path.description: Path or TOS URI to an input protein structure in PDB or mmCIF format. Used only when sequence is not provided. The model extracts standard amino-acid sequences from the structure file.
